title: Q7
description:
“I will be to Him a Father, and He shall be to Me a Son.”
Read: 2Sa 7:11–16, 1Ch 17:11–14
a) In the promise to David, this line comes inside a promise of a house, a throne and a kingdom “established forever.” What does the citation bring forward about the Son's throne, beyond sonship alone?
b) 2Sa 7:14 goes on: “If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him.” Hebrews does not quote that half (1Ch 17:13 also leaves it out). What does that silence point to in this Son (see Heb 4:15)?
